Each hour: time, direction and speed (knots, g = gust), odds of 12kt or more, regime, waves, tide height in ft with r rising or f falling. OUTFLOW NOT RIDDEN = Squamish outflow, never recommend. OFF DIR = direction does not work at that spot.
Riding light (first light to last light, Vancouver): Sun, Nov 8 7:37am to 6:14pm; Mon, Nov 9 7:39am to 6:13pm; Tue, Nov 10 7:40am to 6:12pm. Hours outside that are dark and not listed; never suggest riding then.

Guillermo's own take for Sun, Nov 8 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Howe Sound is way ahead of the page this morning. At 6:53am the Spit was SSE 28 gusting 37 (page about 16), and Pam Rocks read SSE 25 at 6am. Pemberton sits 5 hPa below Vancouver, so the inflow should keep pulling.

My pick is Squamish from first light (about 7:45am) into early afternoon, SSE 25 to 29 with gusts near 38. Small kites, experienced riders only. Check before driving: if the Spit still reads 20 or more at 9am, go.

Porteau is the backup until about 11:30, before the flood kills the swell. The Strait is softer than shown, Sand Heads only S 16.

Rider weed reports (floating weed or eelgrass, last 3 days; mention them when suggesting these spots): Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal Causeway: lots of weed (Fri, Nov 6 12:00).

EC marine forecast, Howe Sound (issued 04:00 PM PCT 08 November 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Tonight and Monday. Strong wind warning in effect. Wind southerly inflow 10 to 20 knots becoming northerly outflow 10 to 20 this evening then increasing to northerly outflow 20 to 30 after midnight. Wind diminishing to northerly outflow 10 to 20 near noon Monday.

EC marine forecast, Strait of Georgia (south of Nanaimo) (issued 04:00 PM PCT 08 November 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Tonight and Monday. Strong wind warning in effect. Wind south 15 to 25 knots diminishing to southerly 5 to 15 early this evening then backing to east 5 to 15 near midnight. Wind increasing to southeast 15 to 20 near noon Monday and to southeast 20 to 25 Monday afternoon. Wind veering to southwest 15 to 20 Monday evening.

Track record, last 30 days: Porteau Cove (scored at Pam Rocks): typical miss 3.78kt, caught 68% of windy hours, 14% false alarms; Steveston - Garry Point Park (scored at Sand Heads): typical miss 2.63kt, caught 80% of windy hours, 18% false alarms; Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal Causeway (scored at Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal): typical miss 2.65kt, caught 63% of windy hours, 16% false alarms; Erwin Park (scored at Point Atkinson): typical miss 3.24kt, caught 49% of windy hours, 26% false alarms. Other spots are not measured yet.
